brief:
Wives of men stranded outside Gaza have called for the reopening of the Rafah crossing, the Ma'an news agency reported. The women, separated from their families by the border closure, are seeking passage to rejoin their husbands.

The Rafah crossing remains a critical humanitarian gateway between Gaza and Egypt. Its status directly affects the ability of separated families to reunite and shapes access to essential supplies and services for Gaza's population.
title: Wives trapped in Gaza demand opening of Rafah crossing
